old.PMU: Whole child user events, including cold JIT and same wrapper; FEXServer outside target tree is excluded. Fresh launcher each sample, no AOT/object cache, OS page cache retained.
old.time: CoreMark loop timer; other cases whole-child simpleperf elapsed including startup/JIT. No cross-workload score aggregation.

current.PMU: Whole child user events, including cold JIT and same wrapper; FEXServer outside target tree is excluded. Fresh launcher each sample, no AOT/object cache, OS page cache retained.
current.time: CoreMark loop timer; other cases whole-child simpleperf elapsed including startup/JIT. No cross-workload score aggregation.

notes: A2 is rejected, not the final accepted implementation; future A3 measurements must remain separate.

All eight fixed cases retain the old seconds<=1.10, user cycles<=1.10, compile excluding byte<=2.0 gates in both scopes; no func_tests exemption. Instructions and branch misses are reported diagnostics, not new gates.
Each runtime/PMU metric is the median of its three observations; ratios divide SVM and same-cohort FEX medians, not paired per-round ratios. No cross-case average.
Each compile decomposition uses the one observation whose total excluding pure byte decode is median. Exclusive group sums close; no sum of independently computed stage medians.

Compile probes are separate diagnostic processes; pure byte timing perturbs compilation. FEX uses CNTVCT exclusive stage ticks; SVM uses stage wall timers and a nonnegative measured residual. Native owner release and FEX logical working-buffer release have different scope.

CoreMark runtime uses100000 iterations and a >=10s loop timer; its compile/work/resource probes use20 iterations. Other timings and all PMU events include the whole child startup/cold JIT; do not subtract diagnostic compile time from ordinary cycles.

func_tests is a functional stdout/exit101 workload but remains performance-gated. x87_bench has only exit compatibility, no numerical output oracle; ext80/CW/unmask coverage belongs to separate pipeline checks, not these runtime records.
IR N/W fields explicitly exclude rejected IR prefixes. Their unknown sizes remain null; all measured failed attempts and Block retries remain charged in compile totals.
published native units and ready PC entries differ after multi-entry publication. Slot element bytes exclude allocator headers/capacity slack elsewhere; no RSS was measured.

Three samples do not establish significance for small shifts. CPU4 policy range is unchanged but not frequency-locked; temperature differs slightly. Old/current absolute changes are historical cohort comparisons, not isolated-hunk causal attribution.
